mapper.sql: o.id, o.name, o.gender, o.id_card, o.phone, o.person_type, o.house_id, o.family_count, o.move_in_date, o.car_plate, o.emergency_name, o.emergency_phone, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time
FROM owner o LEFT JOIN house h ON h.id = o.house_id

where.if: AND (o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.car_plate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR h.house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO owner (name, gender, id_card, phone, person_type, house_id, family_count, move_in_date, car_plate, emergency_name, emergency_phone, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, IFNULL(#{gender}, '男'), #{idCard}, #{phone}, IFNULL(#{personType}, 'OWNER'), #{houseId}, IFNULL(#{familyCount}, 1), #{moveInDate}, #{carPlate}, #{emergencyName}, #{emergencyPhone}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT person_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM owner GROUP BY person_type
